title: Research Associate Trainee – Computer Science
description:
**Research Associate Trainee – Computer Science**

**Location:** Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Mode:** Full-Time | In-Office Only

**Salary**

**Training Period:** ₹10,000 per month

**After Confirmation:** ₹15,000 per month

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic **Research Associate Trainees** who are interested in building a career in academic research, technical writing, and Computer Science research.

This is a structured training role where you will learn how research papers, literature reviews, technical reports, and thesis documents are prepared for international journals and conferences.

You will work under the guidance of experienced researchers and gradually take ownership of research support activities as your skills develop.

**Research Domains**

You will gain exposure to projects in one or more of the following areas:

* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
* Data Science & Analytics
* Computer Vision & Image Processing
* Cybersecurity
* Computer Networks
* Internet of Things (IoT)
* General Computer Science Research

**Training & Responsibilities**

During your training period, you will learn to:

* Search and analyze recent research papers
* Conduct literature reviews and summarize research findings
* Organize references and citations using IEEE and other academic formats
* Format research papers, theses, and technical documents
* Prepare comparison tables and research summaries
* Assist in manuscript preparation and documentation
* Support senior researchers with publication-related activities
* Improve technical writing and academic English
* Learn the research publication process from idea to submission

Responsibilities will gradually increase based on your learning progress and performance.

**A Typical Day in This Role**

You may spend your day:

* Reading and summarizing research papers
* Preparing literature review tables
* Formatting research manuscripts
* Organizing references and citations
* Assisting with technical documentation
* Supporting senior researchers in ongoing projects

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics & Communication, or related disciplines)

**Experience**

* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with up to 1 year of experience in research writing, technical writing, thesis documentation, or academic projects may also apply.

**Preferred Skills**

* Good written and reading skills in English
* Basic understanding of Computer Science concepts
* Strong analytical and logical thinking
* Attention to detail
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Word
* Interest in research and technical documentation
* Willingness to learn new concepts and work in a research-oriented environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Hands-on training in academic research and technical writing
* Exposure to real-world AI and Computer Science research projects
* Structured mentorship from experienced researchers
* Opportunity to contribute to research publications
* Collaborative and learning-focused work environment
* Long-term career growth opportunities

**Career Path**

Research Associate Trainee

↓

Research Associate

↓

Technical Research Engineer

↓

Senior Technical Research Engineer

↓

Research Team Lead

**Selection Process**

**Round 1:** Technical & English Writing Assessment

**Round 2:** Face-to-Face Interview (Mandatory)

**Important Hiring Policy**

* This is a full-time, in-office position based in Gandhipuram, Coimbatore.
* Candidates should be comfortable commuting or relocating before joining.
* Timely communication throughout the recruitment process is expected.
* Candidates who miss interviews without prior notice or repeatedly fail to respond to communication may not be considered for future openings.
* Please apply only if you are genuinely interested in attending the interview and joining if selected.
* Selected candidates must work a minimum of 1 year.

**How to Apply**

**softscholarshrd@gmail.com**

description:
Job Title: A PKI / ADCS Engineer

City: Coimbatore

State/Province: Tamil Nadu

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

* A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
* The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
* The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
* The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
* The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
* The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
* The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
* The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.

Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.  
  
  
  
  

NOTE: Wipro needs immediate joiners only

description:
**Experience Required : 7+ years**  
**Role Overview**

As an Engineering Manager, you will build, mentor, and lead a high-performing engineering team dedicated to delivering reliable, scalable, and business-aligned software. You will serve as the strategic bridge between the engineering and product teams, translating technical constraints, trade-offs, timelines, and risks into clear business language for the executive suite. This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical expertise, agile project management, and strong people leadership to navigate a fast-changing technology landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

●**System Architecture:** Prepare technical design documents and maintain an

updated end-to-end architecture document, including an architecture decision matrix.

●**Resilience & High Availability:** Design high availability, failure, and recovery

protocols for the platform to guarantee zero downtime.

●**Observability:** Design and implement multi-level observability across the platform, including application, database, infrastructure, and integrations.

●**Problem Solving:** Solve complex technical and engineering challenges, delivering appropriate solutions that align with business goals while staying within budget.

**Product Alignment & Execution**

●**Roadmap Collaboration:** Coordinate closely with product owners and managers to jointly drive the product roadmap.

● **Feasibility & Analysis:** Collect, analyze, and action product features, user flows, and integrations, collaborating directly with the product team on implementation feasibility.

●**Agile Delivery:** Oversee technical project management using Agile development methodologies to ensure consistent, timely releases.

**Engineering Excellence & Operations**

●**Best Practices:** Identify and implement engineering, coding, and testing best

practices, while defining clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

●**CI/CD & DevOps:** Design and execute robust 'build & deployment' processes rooted in CI/CD principles.

●**Platform Stability:** Maintain ultimate accountability for production issues, SLAs, defects, technical debt, and overall release stability.

●**Infrastructure & FinOps:** Define required cloud and on-premise infrastructure, plan budgets for future growth, and lead cross-functional teams to establish an operational FinOps framework (including AI infrastructure cost management).

●**Change Management:** Lead process design, continuous process reviews, and

comprehensive change management practices.**Talent & People Management**

●**Team Growth:** Build, manage, and scale a team of proficient engineers, providing regular mentoring and technical guidance.

●**Performance Management:** Define, assess, and execute clear performance plans to foster continuous professional growth within the team.

**Required Technical Skills & Experience**

●**Engineering Leadership:** Proven experience in talent management, technical

project management, and leading engineering teams while remaining functionally hands-on with coding and engineering design.

●**Full-Stack Proficiency:** Deep expertise in transforming end-to-end platforms

leveraging modern tools, including **Node, Python, Next.js, MongoDB, APIs, REST Services,** and **microservices**.

●**Cloud & Infrastructure:** Strong experience with the **AWS Cloud platform**, multiple system integration techniques, and infrastructure budgeting.

●**AI Engineering:** Conversant with the broader LLM and AI ecosystem, with a distinct focus on AI engineering—specifically integrating AI into practical business solutions rather than just building isolated GenAI models.

●**Security & Privacy:** Robust understanding of data privacy, data security, and

application security best practices.

title: VP - Platform
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The VP Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.  

  

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

description:

This is a critical and urgent opportunity for a Specialist - Cloud & Infra Management to join our team in Coimbatore. title: Pricing & CPQ - Analyst 2
description:
**Job Title \- Pricing \& CPQ \- Analyst \- ACS SONG**

**Management Level: Level 11 \- Analyst**

**Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad**

**Must have skills: PROS Smart Price Optimization**

**Good to have skills: Pricing Tools**

**Experience: 2\-3 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


Results\-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid\-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote\-to\-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross\-functional teams—sales, finance, product, and IT—to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
* Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
* Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client’s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
* Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
* Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis \& Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
* Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best\-in\-class KPIs
* Work as an integral part of the client’s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
* You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing \& CPQ area.
* The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

  

**Professional and Technical Skills:**

* 2\-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications \& High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
* Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization \& Management (POM) \& Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
* Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Knowledge of other Pricing \& CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

**Additional Information**

* Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
* PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management  

PROS Smart Configure Price Quote
